maya: Heads-up: rolling canary for release v2.14.1 starts in 30m (2024-06-05 15:00 PT). Please ack. Backout runbook here: https://go/release/runbook/v2.14.1

Pin details: currently pinned to commit abc123 on prod. Unpin target if needed: tag release-2.14.0

Checks to validate before go: health endpoints, latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-gen failures. I'll be watch for 5m after canary. @liam @sana

liam: Ack. I'll own canary window. I have stage logs open. I'll watch p95 and errors. If p95 > 300ms or errors > 1% rollback. :thumbsup:

sana: Dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/runs/v2.14.1. Added alert on paged thresholds. Also verify KV cache hit rate — see runbook section 3: 'cache invalidation'

ryan: Added the emergency unpin command to this thread:
```
# rollback to previous pinned release
scripts/unpin.sh --tag release-2.14.0 --force
```
Use only if canary fails AND infra approves.

deploybot: canary rollout scheduled in 30m. Will start 10 instances in canary pool and expand on green. Logs: https://ci/release/1736008142

ops-bot: Preflight check passed: all required runbook playbooks present. Escape hatch ARN: arn:aws:ssm:us-west-2:123456789012:runbook/unpin-v2.14.1

liam: Good. One more: if errors spike but latency ok, do a canary pause + investigate for 10m before unpin. Call for +1 from infra.

sana: +1. I'll watch logs for model-serving OOM traces (OOM count in logs).

ryan: I'll be standing by for manual pin if needed. If I run the unpin script, I'll paste the command output here.

maya: Thanks team. If we unpin we should also run the DB migration revert checklist in runbook section 6. Link repeated: https://go/release/runbook/v2.14.1#section-6
